context: Naoko visits Saito for a pre-move health check.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 直子さん、田舎、移るんですね。
lines.en: So you're moving out to the countryside, Naoko-san.
lines.style: Warm, gentle opening. Voice carries quiet approval and genuine interest. Soft composure throughout—the kind of doctor who listens more than she directs.

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.jp: はい、新しい生活、始めます。
lines.en: Yes. I'm starting a new chapter out there.
lines.style: Firm but gentle declaration. Voice carries hope beneath the practicality—someone ready for change but grateful for what came before. Slight warmth in the cadence.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.en: Taking care of your health will be important, you know.
lines.style: Measured, caring advice. Not lecturing—more like a quiet reminder from someone who knows her well. Voice settles on the word 'important' with steady weight.

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.jp: 田舎、自然、たくさんあって、安心。
lines.en: Out there there's so much nature around. It puts me at ease.
lines.style: Reflective, almost philosophical. Voice opens up slightly—she's imagining it, feeling it. Quiet confidence underneath. Not rushed.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 相談、いつでも、来てください。
lines.en: Come see me anytime you need to talk things through.
lines.style: Warm promise, quietly delivered. The word 'anytime' carries real weight—she means it. Voice opens slightly on the invitation, then settles into gentle sincerity.

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.jp: 本当に、お世話になりました。
lines.en: I've truly been in your care all this time. Thank you so much.
lines.style: Soft, genuine gratitude. Voice carries both humility and deep respect. Slight tremor of real emotion—not performed, but felt. Slows slightly on the thanks.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: お元気で、また会いましょう。
lines.en: Take care of yourself. Let's meet again someday.
lines.style: Closing warmth. Voice carries both a gentle wish and quiet certainty. The promise is real, not ceremonial. Slight softening at the very end—she'll miss her.
